Macrocephaly-intellectual disability-autism syndrome is occasionally (29-5%) associated with Cafe-au-lait spot, Depressed nasal bridge, Hypotonia, Intestinal polyposis, Multiple lipomas, Numerous nevi, and Penile freckling. Macrocephaly-intellectual disability-autism syndrome is very rarely (<4-1%) associated with Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, Foot polydactyly, Frontal bossing, Hepatic steatosis, Hurthle cell thyroid adenoma, Hypertelorism, Lymphoid nodular hyperplasia, Midface retrusion, Preaxial hand polydactyly, Seizure, Short nose, and Thyroid carcinoma.Macrocephaly-intellectual disability-autism syndrome is associated with Disease-causing germline mutation(s) in phosphatase and tensin homolog (MMAC1; PTEN1; TEP1; mutated in multiple advanced cancers 1; Phosphatidylinositol 3; 4; 5-trisphosphate 3-phosphatase and dual-specificity protein phosphatase PTEN) and hepatic and glial cell adhesion molecule (FLJ25530; GLIALCAM; glial cell adhesion molecule; hepaCAM).

Activated PI3K-delta syndrome is very frequently (99-80%) associated with Pneumonia and Recurrent upper and lower respiratory tract infections. Activated PI3K-delta syndrome is frequently (79-30%) associated with Autoimmunity, B lymphocytopenia, Bronchiectasis, Chronic sinusitis, Decreased circulating antibody level, Hepatomegaly, Increased circulating IgM level, Intestinal lymphoid nodular hyperplasia, Lymphadenopathy, Recurrent otitis media, and Splenomegaly. Activated PI3K-delta syndrome is occasionally (29-5%) associated with Abnormal intestine morphology, Arthritis, Failure to thrive, Hearing impairment, Lymphoma, Microcephaly, Neurodevelopmental delay, Recurrent tonsillitis, Severe Epstein Barr virus infection, Severe cytomegalovirus infection, and Severe varicella zoster infection.
